Contributing to FunMel

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

FunMel’s source repository is https://github.com/mghotbi/FunMel. Report reproducible problems through https://github.com/mghotbi/FunMel/issues. Include the package version, sessionInfo(), relevant metadata structure and an example that can be shared. Avoid posting private images or credentials.

Development setup

Work from the package root, where DESCRIPTION is located. Install the package development tools and declared dependencies:

install.packages(c("devtools", "testthat", "knitr", "rmarkdown", "png", "withr"))
devtools::install_deps(dependencies=TRUE)
devtools::load_all()

Source compilation requires an appropriate compiler and the system libraries used by magick. Installation instructions are in the README.

Checks before committing

devtools::document() # when changing exported functions or roxygen comments
devtools::test()
devtools::check()

Alternatively, build and check from a terminal:

R CMD build .
R CMD check --no-manual FunMel_0.3.7.tar.gz

Inspect warnings, notes and model/image diagnostics; successful software checks do not establish biological segmentation accuracy or validate a new assay. Retain matched-control rules and independent plate IDs in any new examples. For algorithm changes, rerun the simulation validation script and inspect representative photograph masks. See inst/guides/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md for scope.

Source files and Git

Track authored R/, src/, man/, vignettes/, tests/, inst/, README.md, NEWS.md, DESCRIPTION and LICENSE. The project includes .gitignore and .Rbuildignore; these development files are normally excluded from the installed package. Exclude native compiled objects, local credentials, private photographs and generated analysis folders. Bundled example and validation assets are separate from private working folders and should be reviewed before public distribution.

Documentation website

install.packages("pkgdown")
pkgdown::build_site()

pkgdown builds the website from the README, generated reference help and vignettes. It is a development tool, not an analysis dependency. Configure website URLs and hosting for the repository; review the docs/ ignore rule if using a hosting setup that requires generated files in Git. Generated website files are not included in this source bundle.
